summary: Feature implemented in the working tree, nothing committed, no tests run. New modules: monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver). Added plot_2d_or_3d_image to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py. Rewrote the segmentation, classification, and TensorBoard image handlers as thin adapters over the savers and plot function. Changed the write_nifti default dtype to np.float32. Renamed output_path to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py; the classification handler test now passes filename. Added tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py. Choices: CSV rows now written in insertion order (previously sorted by key), so default-path row order changes; the TensorBoard handler calls batch_transform once per call. Unverified: no tests executed, and imports were not checked by running code.
